trust_decision.summary: Which caller-supplied delta keys / JSON Pointer segments may be used as property names when walking and writing into the target (or into a freshly built reversed delta); decided per key in the nested patch/reverse filters and in the RFC 6902 path parser.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'patch APIs'; jsondiffpatch.patch() runs the patch pipe whose object filter reads context.left[name] for every delta key with no own-property or key check.

fix_sites.module_kind: core patch filter (write-back of child results)
core reverse filter (writes keys into fresh reversed delta)
second implementation: RFC 6902 apply inside a formatter module documented as a testing aid

fix_sites.entry_point: jsondiffpatch/formatters/jsonpatch patch() op 'add' (also reached by move/copy and rollback)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: jsonpatch-apply.ts documents itself as 'used for testing to ensure the JSON-Patch formatter output is correct' (packages/jsondiffpatch/src/formatters/jsonpatch-apply.ts:23) and lives under formatters/, so a solver focused on the delta patch API can call it a test helper outside the 'patch APIs' report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Objects with a legitimate own 'constructor' (or 'prototype') property must still diff/patch correctly; a fix that blocks 'constructor' in the delta pipeline (as the JSON Patch fix does) breaks this. Also JSON Pointer '~0'/'~1' escaped segments and the '-' append segment must keep working, and RFC 6902 rollback atomicity must hold.

O6_input_shapes: own '__proto__' key in a JSON.parse'd object delta (fix.diff:217)
nested 'constructor' -> 'prototype' delta chain that walks inherited properties of left (fix.diff:204-210, guarded by hasOwnProperty on left fix.diff:38-43)
inherited (non-own) enumerable keys on the delta object itself (fix.diff:34, fix.diff:81)
non-object left reaching the object write-back (fix.diff:60-63)
same keys via reverse()/unpatch() reversed-delta construction (fix.diff:80, fix.diff:97)
JSON Pointer segments '__proto__' / 'constructor' / 'prototype' after ~0/~1 decoding, silently skipped for add and thrown for replace/remove/move/copy/test (fix.diff:137-144, fix.diff:156-157)

O7_producer.where: packages/jsondiffpatch/src/filters/arrays.ts:436-448 (reverse of an array-move item computes newName = '_' + attacker-controlled delta[1]); written at packages/jsondiffpatch/src/filters/arrays.ts:535-545

O8_uncovered_routes.route: reverse()/unpatch() of an array delta: a move item's target index becomes the reversed key via newName, so a value such as '_proto__' yields the key '__proto__' written into the fresh reversed array delta with no key check (the identical write in nested.ts is what fix.diff:97 guards).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The key is computed from a numeric-looking move index, not taken from a delta key, and the write lands on a freshly built delta object rather than the user's target or Object.prototype, so it looks like 'array index handling', not prototype pollution.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different file (filters/arrays.ts) from landing point filters/nested.ts; sink at packages/jsondiffpatch/src/filters/arrays.ts:542-545

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Array patch and array reverse iterate the delta with for-in and no own-property check, so inherited keys on a delta object (e.g. one whose prototype was replaced by the route above) are applied; the fix added this exact hasOwnProperty check only to the object filters.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Array deltas only use '_t', numeric and '_n' keys parsed with parseInt, so a solver can argue no dangerous name can reach a property write there.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Values inserted by the JSON Patch apply (and the public clone()) go through clone(), which copies an own '__proto__' key of the value with a plain assignment, setting the prototype of the cloned object placed into the target.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix's concern is the path, not the value; clone is a generic utility only ever applied to data and the effect stays on the cloned object, not a built-in prototype.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: array collectChildren write-back keyed by a string childName instead of a parsed number (e.g. supporting keyed/objectHash moves).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: childName is already typed loosely and cast (arrays.ts:420); a maintainer adding keyed array moves would plausibly key by the hash string.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a type-specific patch branch (e.g. for Date or Map-like values) that rebuilds the result by copying delta-supplied fields by key, next to the existing RegExp rebuild.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The trivial patch filter already reconstructs RegExp values from delta content; a merge-style reconstruction for another value type is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a pre-parsed string[] path route into get()/add() that skips parsePathFromRFC6902 (get already accepts arrays at line 147).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: get() already takes either a string or a pre-split array; exposing a 'patch by segments' helper is a plausible API addition and would bypass a parser-only check.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) via caller-supplied keys in delta / JSON Patch application

O10_build.project_tests: packages/jsondiffpatch/test/index.spec.ts (patch/unpatch/reverse examples via test/examples/diffpatch.ts), packages/jsondiffpatch/test/formatters/jsonpatch.spec.ts (JSON Patch apply)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Skip '__proto__' (or blocklist '__proto__'/'constructor'/'prototype') in nested.ts patchFilter only, leaving reverse/unpatch, the array filters and the JSON Patch apply untouched, or breaking objects with an own 'constructor' key.

out_of_scope_notes: diff(): nested.ts collectChildrenDiffFilter writes child results into a fresh delta keyed by own keys of right (packages/jsondiffpatch/src/filters/nested.ts:18-22), so an own '__proto__' key in right sets the produced delta's prototype; diff is not a patch API, not pursued.
jsonpatch-apply get() uses 'key in acc' and so resolves inherited properties for any segment not blocklisted (packages/jsondiffpatch/src/formatters/jsonpatch-apply.ts:160-166); noted only.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell used); tiny_repo is inferred from the source tree being ~29 TypeScript files across packages/jsondiffpatch/src and packages/diff-mcp/src.

O8 routes 1 and 3 change the prototype of a freshly built object (reversed delta / cloned value), not Object.prototype; they fall within the advisory's protection only by analogy to the fix's own guard at fix.diff:97. Whether they reach a built-in prototype after the published fix was not established; hidden tests would assert on the produced object's shape/inherited keys.
Pipe ordering for the array move reverse route was read from packages/jsondiffpatch/src/diffpatcher.ts:44-55 but not executed.
